bridge.msg.tool_calling_addendum:
[Function Calling Tool Rules]
- This connection uses standard Function Calling (tools) mode.
- Whenever you need to inspect status, locations, recipes, or memories, or run in-game actions, goals, or memory updates, call the provided functions (tools) directly instead of writing JSON actions.
- After checking tool results, write a natural plain-text reply matching your persona and the sender/client language (no Markdown; plain text without JSON is also accepted).
- Do not duplicate actions already executed via tools in any final JSON actions array.
